welcome.title: Welcome to FadeUp
welcome.subtitle: Three questions to personalise what you'll see. You can skip them all.

name.title: What should we call you?
name.why: Useful when you book — never shown publicly.

gender.title: You are… ?
gender.why: Optional. Only used to surface barbershops or mixed salons. You can change or clear it any time from your account.

frequency.title: How often do you get a haircut?
frequency.why: So we can, later on, remind you to book at the right time.

account.title: Your account is coming
account.body: Sign-in, your Fade Passport and your preferences arrive in the next release (M1b).

search.cityHint: Search by city, or use “Near me”.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address doesn't match any screen.

auth.title: Quick sign-in
auth.body: An email is enough — a six-digit code, and you pick up exactly where you left off.
auth.contextFollow: Sign in to follow this profile.
auth.contextLike: Sign in to like this post.
auth.contextBookings: Sign in to see your bookings.
auth.contextAccount: Sign in to manage your account.
auth.googleFailed: Google sign-in didn't complete. Try again, or use the email code.

offline.banner: Offline — nothing can update right now.
offline.blockedBody: This screen needs the network to show up-to-date data. Nothing stale will be shown.
offline.queueBlockedBody: Your position changes constantly: rather than show a stale number, this screen waits for the network.

feed.title: Feed
feed.emptyBody: Follow barbers and shops to fill your feed — or explore search.

account.title: Account
account.signedOutBody: Sign in to see your bookings, favorites and follows.
account.unfollowBody: You'll stop seeing their activity. Unfollowing lasts: a booking won't follow them again automatically — only tapping Follow on their profile will.
account.notifBody: Push notifications arrive in an upcoming version. Your preferences are kept on this device and will apply as soon as they exist.
account.passportBody: Your FadeUp passport — it arrives in an upcoming version; its place is reserved here.
account.deleteBody: Deletion is immediate and permanent — there is no cooling-off period. Your personal data goes: account, profile, Passport and its photos, follows, favourites, notifications, and the contact details shops hold for you.
account.prefsPurpose: These two answers only shape discovery — surfacing barbershops or mixed salons. They are shown nowhere: not on your profile, not to shops.
account.deleteKept: What stays, and why: your past appointments stay with the shop without your name or contact details, because they are its books; your published reviews stay online without an author, so that closing your account cannot change a professional's reputation.
account.deleteFinal: Last step. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteDoneBody: It's done. You'll be signed out of this device.
account.deleteReceipt: Your deletion receipt (keep it if you may want to ask us about this later):

deleteRefusal.not_authenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again, then retry.
deleteRefusal.business_account: This account runs a business on FadeUp. Deleting it would leave its team and its customers' appointments without an owner. Transfer ownership of the business, then retry.
deleteRefusal.active_commitments: You have an active queue or an upcoming appointment. Leave the queue and cancel your appointments first: erasing them would leave the shop a slot held by someone unreachable.
deleteRefusal.media_not_purged: Your photos could not be deleted. Try again — without that, nothing is erased.
deleteRefusal.unknown: The deletion did not go through. Try again in a moment.

account.exportReady: Here is what FadeUp holds about you.

queuex.cameraPermissionBody: The camera is only used to read the QR displayed in the shop.
queuex.cameraDenied: Camera access is denied. Allow it in Settings to scan the shop's QR.
queuex.consultFromAnywhere: The wait can be checked from anywhere — joining happens at the shop, QR in hand.
queuex.keptAwake: The screen stays on while you wait.

bookingx.expiredCallFirstBody: A call often settles it in a minute. This shop hasn't published its number in FadeUp — you'll find it on site or online.
bookingx.resumeNotice: Your slot is kept — sign in to finish.
bookingx.noPreferenceHours: No time left to suggest on this day — pick another one.
bookingx.loadFailedBody: Nothing stale is shown to you. Try again in a moment.
